title: Statement Intake & Bulk Import
subtitle: Receive every carrier statement, fingerprint it, queue it for processing — single file or hundreds at once.
what_it_does:
Statement Intake is the front door for everything Cash Hub does. Files arrive — Excel, CSV, or PDF — and the system fingerprints each one (a hash of its structural shape), matches it to a saved template if one exists, and queues it for processing.

Two flavors live side by side: **single-file upload** for ad-hoc statements during the month, and **bulk import** for the month-end batch where the accounting team drops a folder of hundreds of files and walks away. Both go through the same downstream pipeline.
the_problem:
Brokerages receive commission statements from **200+ carriers** every month, each in its own format. Today this is manual: an analyst opens each one and re-keys the data into the GL. New carriers add days of re-keying work. Errors compound silently; the close slips by hours per missed match.

The industry pain point Jim B captured at [097:48 of the transcript]: *"It's not unusual for them to get 200 pages of PDF statements and a check of 4 million."* That's a single carrier, one month. Multiply by 200 carriers and you have the workload that *needs* automation.
what_user_does: **Single file:** drop a PDF/Excel/CSV on the upload zone, optionally pick the template manually, hit Upload. System creates a `StatementHeader` shell + saves the file to blob storage.

**Bulk:** open `/StatementsBulkImport`, drag a folder, watch the per-file fingerprint match. Files that fingerprint to an existing template auto-progress; files that don't fall into 'Awaiting Template' for follow-up.
**Track progress** on the Statements list (`/Statements`) — stage chips at the top show how many are Ingesting / Processed / Deposit Matched / Cash Matching / Approved.
**Handle failures** — anything that fails fingerprint matching needs a super user to author or assign a template in Mapping Studio.
business_value: Onboarding a new carrier statement format drops from **2 days of analyst work to minutes** once the template is built. Month-end bulk-import turns a multi-day, error-prone process into an unattended overnight pipeline. Bottom line: the brokerage's commission intake scales with carrier count, not with headcount.

title: Mapping Studio (AI Template Authoring)
subtitle: Google Gemini proposes how each carrier's statement maps to canonical fields. A human reviewer approves. New format onboarded in minutes.
what_it_does:
Mapping Studio (titled *Statement Studio* in the UI) is the screen where templates get authored, refined, and re-validated. It takes a statement in any format and uses **Google Gemini** to propose how each column maps into the canonical schema (Customer, Product, Gross Amount, Billing Date, Provider, etc.). A human reviewer accepts or overrides each suggestion; the resulting template handles every subsequent statement from that carrier automatically.

Three entry points, same screen:

- **`/MappingStudio`** — empty drop-zone; start a brand-new template
- **`/MappingStudio/{TemplateId}`** — open an existing template for refinement (the hero shot above shows Humana Excel 2 with its full section sidebar + source preview)
- **`/MappingStudio/statement/{StatementId}`** — Review mode anchored to a specific statement, with the PDF + extracted grid side-by-side
the_problem:
Without templates, every statement is a manual analyst task forever. The industry's existing solutions either (a) require a rules engineer to author per-carrier mappings (slow, expensive) or (b) tolerate 40% match rates and assign humans to the rest.

Mapping Studio's AI assist isn't decorative — it's the productivity multiplier. Gemini's suggestions cover the *easy* mappings (carrier column 'GROSS_COMM' → canonical 'Gross Amount') so the reviewer can focus on the *hard* ones (carrier code 'PREM' = canonical 'Premium' for benefits but 'Premium Adjustment' for P&C).
what_user_does: **Author a new template:** open `/MappingStudio`, name + describe, drop a sample carrier file, walk the wizard (Upload → Show File → Map Fields → Test Extraction → Save). Accept the AI's column suggestions; override anything wrong; preview-extract; save.

**Refine an existing template:** open via the template list or `/MappingStudio/{TemplateId}`. Section sidebar lets you re-map any concept independently (Mapping, Value Mapping Suggestions, Plan Type, Billing Date, Comparison, Extra Fields, More Options).
**Validate on a real statement:** from any StatementDetails → Statement Review tab → 'Open in Statement Studio' — see the PDF on the left, the extracted grid on the right, fix what extracted wrong.
**Approve template:** flip from InProgress → Active when satisfied. Activates fingerprint matching for future statements from this carrier.
business_value: The single most differentiated capability in ERP Unite. Carrier onboarding cost drops from **2 days per format → 30 minutes**. Carrier format changes mid-year stop blocking the close — a super user refreshes the template and the next month's statements flow through. The AI suggestion path means template authoring becomes a reviewable task instead of a developer task — the business owns its own templates.
technical_anchors:
**AI:** `IAIModelGoogleService` (Gemini wrapper); every inference logged by `IAITraceService` (prompt + response + latency + tokens).

**OCR:** `OcrRegionCommandHandler` for PDF region-extraction.

**Entities:** `StatementTemplate`, `StatementTemplateColumn`, `StatementTemplateColumnAIReference`, `StatementMapping`, `StatementFilters`.

**Pages:** `Components/Pages/Statements/MappingStudio.razor` + a dozen shared components (`UploadStep`, `ShowFileStep`, `MapFieldsStep`, `ExpressionBuilder`, `FieldMappingRow`, `FilePreview`, `NLPromptPanel`, `ValueMappingPanel`).

**Command bundle (under `Commands/Statements/MappingStudio/`):** `DetectProviderCommandHandler`, `SuggestColumnMappingsCommandHandler`, `SuggestValueMappingsCommandHandler`, `PreviewExtractionCommandHandler`, `PreviewColumnScriptCommandHandler`, `ExtractWithProvenanceCommandHandler`, `AcceptMappingStudioResultCommandHandler`, `ActivateStatementTemplateCommandHandler`, `GenerateNLPromptScriptCommandHandler`, `SaveColumnMappingsCommandHandler`, `SaveValueMappingsCommandHandler`, `UpdateTemplateAIPromptCommandHandler`.

**Services:** `StatementMappingEnrichmentOrchestrator`, `StatementProvenanceEnrichmentService`, `MappingStudioExcelColumnMappingService`, `MappingStudioPdfFirstPassService`, `MappingStudioStructuredExcelExtractionService`.

**Policy:** `Statement.CanManageTemplates`.

title: Statement Detail Workflow (the 6-Tab Deep Dive)
subtitle: Every statement opens into a tabbed work surface: Dashboard / Lines (Original) / Lines / Statement Review / Unmatched / Review & Approve.
what_it_does:
When you open one statement, the page is a 6-tab work surface that takes that single statement from raw-extraction-output all the way to GL-posted. The user stays inside the same statement's context the whole way through — no jumping between screens, no losing your place.

- **Dashboard** — stage stepper, summary stats, action buttons; the orientation screen
- **Statement Lines (Original)** — immutable raw extraction; audit trail back to the source file
- **Statement Lines** — transformed rows (after template rules applied); editable per-row
- **Statement Review** — side-by-side PDF preview + extracted grid + validation chips + Approve Template / Approve Statement buttons
- **Unmatched** — manual reconciliation surface for cash app lines the matching engine couldn't auto-resolve
- **Review & Approve** — the closing tab; approve matched lines for GL posting via the AH integration
